This can help individuals to stay grounded and focused on what is important to them. 3. **Reflection and introspection**: Regularly consulting a guiding text can encourage reflection and introspection, helping individuals to examine their thoughts, feelings, and actions. In your case, returning to the Quran and Hadith when facing difficulties can provide a sense of comfort, guidance, and direction.
